title: Software
text: This page collects open-source R tools developed under Sollenberger Actuarial Technologies.

title: Software
text:
ratingtables
ratingtables provides tools for transparent, reproducible insurance rating workflows.
The package is intended for actuaries and analysts who need to move between human-readable rating tables and programmatic rating processes without hiding the mechanics of the calculation.

Areas of functionality

Long-form factor tables
Batch rating
Rating traces
Validation
Coverage-specific specifications
Interactions
Continuous rating variables
Custom rating functions
Implementation-oriented workflows

title: Sollenberger Actuarial Technologies
text:
Sollenberger Actuarial Technologies is a home for open-source software and technical work related to insurance rating, predictive modeling, and actuarial workflows.
The focus is practical: tools that make actuarial work more transparent, reproducible, and easier to move between analytical and production environments.

title: Sollenberger Actuarial Technologies

Featured software

ratingtables
ratingtables is an R package for building transparent and reproducible insurance rating workflows from long-form factor tables.
It is designed around practical rating needs, including batch rating, traceability, validation, coverage-specific logic, interactions, custom functions, and implementation-oriented workflows.

title: About
text:
Greg Sollenberger is a property and casualty actuary and predictive modeler.
He has worked in insurance since 2008 and has been a Fellow of the Casualty Actuarial Society (FCAS) since 2014. He is also a Certified Specialist in Predictive Analytics (CSPA) and holds a master’s degree in Physics from The Ohio State University.
His experience includes several years in insurance pricing and more than a decade building predictive models for auto and homeowners insurance.
That work has included:

GLMs and gradient-boosted models for homeowners and auto class plans
Insurance pricing and segmentation
Retention modeling
Portfolio profitability analysis integrating pricing and retention models
Model review and documentation
Translating analytical models into usable rating and business workflows
